name: [BETA] Urban Reload 💀
desc:
Welcome to Urban Reload 💀

🏙️ Tactical PvP in a city where every street is a fight.

⚔️ Take on other players in intense gunfights
💀 You lose your weapons, so play smart
🎒 Take down enemies and loot their guns
🧟 Farm to grind cash fast
💥 Realistic guns, attachments and rare camos
🚗 Unlock and customize your own cars
👥 Create a crew and dominate together
🏆 Climb the global leaderboards

🔔 New updates coming regularly!
